events.text: I need to talk to someone about my order tonight. It was supposed to be here by 6:00 and didn't show up until 7:20, which ruined my son's birthday party. The kids had already given up and eaten the chips.

I'm sorry your son's birthday party was disrupted. I want to help with this.

First I need to verify your identity. Please give me the full name on the account and either the email address or phone number on it.
Marcus Lee. The email on the account is marcus.lee@inbox.example.

I've added $15.00 in account credit to your account. You can use it on a future order. Late deliveries are compensated with credit only, not a refund to your card.

I'm sorry again that your son's party was disrupted. Is there anything else I can help with, such as a missing or wrong item in this order? If you'd like a person to follow up, I can pass your case to a specialist.
Fifteen dollars? That's not even close. I was looking for at least $40, or my money back. I can't believe you think a pizza that arrived more than an hour late is worth $15.

I understand why $15 feels small after a ruined party. It's the most I can give for a late delivery. Late deliveries are credited at 20% of the subtotal, capped at $15, and they can't be refunded to your card. I can't go above that, and I can't make goodwill exceptions.

Here's what I can do:
- **Missing or wrong items:** If anything in the order was missing or incorrect, tell me which items. You can choose a refund to your card or account credit of the item price plus 20%. This has to be reported within 48 hours of delivery, so you're still in time.
- **Specialist follow-up:** If you'd like to talk with a person, I can escalate your case and a specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise what the outcome will be.

Would you like either of those?
Fifteen dollars and a lecture about percentages. Another app gave me a $50 credit once when something similar happened, so I know this isn't the best you can do. I want $40 or my money back.

I'm sorry this is frustrating. I can't offer $40 or a refund to your card for this delivery. The late-delivery compensation is set by policy at $15 in credit for an order this late, and I can't change it. What other apps do doesn't change what I'm able to give.

The $15 credit is already on your account. There are two other things I can do:

1. **Report a problem with the items.** If anything was missing or wrong, tell me which items and I'll look at a refund or credit for them.
2. **Escalate to a specialist.** I can pass this to a person who will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise they'll change the outcome.

Would you like me to do either one?

Fine. I'm not happy about it, but I'm not going to keep arguing with a script. I'll take the $15 credit this time. Escalate it to a specialist too, because I want someone to look at this properly and not just paste the same answer back at me.
